purpose: Create deterministic, collision-aware identifiers for certified territories, political parties/lists and historical office-holders before any 2026 B2 claim is admitted or any feature matrix is constructed.

scope.territories: 92 certified local constituencies and 12 certified regional constituencies.
scope.parties: Every list code observed in the canonical 2011, 2016 and 2021 election files plus every party code observed among the 395 elected members in 2021.
scope.lists: One deterministic list_id per observed year, scope, certified territory and actual party/list code.
scope.people: The 395 observed elected-member rows for 2021, keyed primarily by the TAFRA idperson and never merged only by name.
scope.2026_candidates: No 2026 candidate is admitted by this gate. Legacy aggregate coverage is recorded as LEAD_ONLY_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED because it lacks B2 record-level provenance.

normalization.unicode: NFKC followed by controlled diacritic removal for Latin and Arabic text.
normalization.whitespace: Collapse all Unicode whitespace to a single ASCII space and trim.
normalization.punctuation: Normalize apostrophes and dashes, then replace remaining punctuation separators with spaces.
normalization.arabic: Remove tatweel and harakat; normalize Arabic alef variants to ا, alif maqsura to ي, waw-hamza to و and ya-hamza to ي. Ta marbuta is not collapsed.
normalization.latin: Remove combining diacritics after canonical decomposition; retain alphanumeric tokens.
normalization.digits: Normalize Arabic-Indic and Extended Arabic-Indic digits to ASCII digits.
forbidden: merging two people because their normalized names match

territory_identity.local_id: Use the existing certified constituency_id from local_92_closure_v3.json.
territory_identity.regional_id: Prefix reg- to the deterministic slug of the authoritative French regional name.
local_alias_sources: TAFRA constituency name already paired in local_92_closure_v3.json
exact normalized names observed in the canonical 2011/2016/2021 files and the 2021 elected-member file
regional_alias_sources: region labels present in the certified local geometry
exact normalized region labels present in canonical historical and elected-member files
territory_identity.alias_acceptance: An alias is admitted only when it maps uniquely after the frozen normalizer or appears in the explicit reviewed_aliases object below.
territory_identity.collision_rule: Any alias resolving to more than one territory fails the gate; no first-match rule is allowed.

party_identity.primary_key: Actual source list code, uppercased and punctuation-normalized.
party_identity.reporting_bucket_rule: Core codes retain their own reporting bucket; every other actual legal list code maps to OTHER only after legal allocation and remains individually identifiable in the list registry.
party_identity.unknown_code_rule: A non-empty historical code is a stable observed code even if its full label is unavailable. It is retained with full_name=null and cannot be guessed from an acronym.
party_identity.alias_rule: Only frozen official French/Arabic full names and exact codes are aliases. Later aliases require a versioned reviewed alias entry.

person_identity.name_key: Normalized full name is a search key, never the primary identity.
person_identity.future_candidate_key: For a new 2026 person without an authoritative stable ID, use candidate:<normalized_name>:<exact_birthdate_or_na> only when the name key is unique in the current registry; otherwise state UNRESOLVED_COLLISION.
person_identity.birthdate_rule: Approximate age, birth year or media-estimated age cannot disambiguate or replace an exact birthdate.
person_identity.collision_rule: Same normalized name across distinct person IDs remains separate and is published as a collision group. Conflicting names for the same stable ID fail the gate.

list_identity.presence_semantics: A historical list_id means a positive-vote list was observed in the canonical historical result. It makes no statement about 2026 ballot registration.
list_identity.2026_rule: No list:2026 identifier receives BALLOT_PRESENT=true until a B2-admissible authoritative ballot record exists.

gate_pass_conditions: Exactly 92 local IDs summing to 305 seats and 12 regional IDs summing to 90 seats.
Every canonical historical local row maps to exactly one certified local ID without fuzzy matching.
Every canonical historical regional row maps to exactly one certified region ID without fuzzy matching.
All 395 elected-member rows map to one certified territory: 305 local and 90 regional.
All observed party codes are retained and every historical positive-vote list obtains one unique deterministic list_id.
Stable person and seat IDs are internally consistent; normalized-name collisions are reported but never merged.
Zero 2026 candidate/list facts are admitted from the legacy aggregate coverage summary.
Zero B2 evidence claim record exists before crosswalk certification.
failure_rule: Any unresolved territory, conflicting stable person ID, alias collision, duplicate list_id or pre-existing uncertified B2 claim keeps B2-2 OPEN. No fuzzy fallback is permitted.
